name: api-cost
description: Shows what each request, the session and the billing month would cost at Claude API list prices, read from the transcripts

billingDay.title: Billing day
billingDay.description: Day of the month (1-28) your subscription renews, when the monthly total resets; 0 reads it from your Claude login

planPrice.title: Plan price (USD/month)
planPrice.description: What your subscription costs in USD/month (Pro $20, Max $100 or $200); 0 reads the plan from your Claude login

prices.title: Price overrides
prices.description: JSON of model prefix to [input, output, cache read] USD per million tokens, e.g. {"opus-5-5": [4, 20, 0.2]}

pricesUrl.title: Prices URL
pricesUrl.description: Where the mod downloads up-to-date model prices once a day (the prices.json in its repository); empty uses the built-in table only
